除了 Final Cut Camera 嘅重大更新之外，Apple 仲公佈咗 Pages、Keynote、Numbers、Pixelmator Pro 同 Freeform 嘅更新。以下係今輪更新嘅新功能。

Apple rolls out 'Creator Studio' app updates, with some new features available even without a subscription

Apple today announced new features for its popular iWork suite—Pages, Keynote, and Numbers—along with several improvements for Pixelmator Pro and Freeform.

Some of the new features are exclusive to Apple Creator Studio subscribers, but others are available to all users. Here's a roundup of all the new features, compiled from Apple's press release:

Pages, Keynote, Numbers

Apple says the update now lets users ask Siri questions about Pages, Keynote, or Numbers and get answers. It's not yet clear whether Apple Intelligence is required, but that seems likely. The update also adds the ability to 'request access to shared presentations, documents, or spreadsheets,' making collaboration easier, as the file owner no longer needs to proactively enable sharing.

Pages for Mac gains a 'Screen View' mode that 'makes content easier to read and helps you focus on writing.' Numbers adds 'trigonometric, statistical, and logic functions' to help users solve complex problems in spreadsheets.

Additionally, Apple Creator Studio subscribers get access to new templates and themes across all three iWork apps. Keynote also gains smart slide generation that can automatically produce suitable images based on the content of a presentation.

Pixelmator Pro

Pixelmator Pro for iPad gains the selection and masking tools previously available only on the Mac version. Both the Mac and iPad versions add two new sets of templates designed for sports and motion-themed projects, as well as new templates designed for 'launching new creative concepts, businesses, or products.'

Excerpted from a popular comment by Richard Lewis (Rich)

Many have asked whether the standalone version of Pixelmator Pro will receive updates. The answer is no (no updates have been announced so far). The current 3.8 version has gone nearly five months without an update.

Additionally, a new Podcast category has been added, making it easier to create cover artwork sized for major podcast platforms.

Freeform

What's your favorite new feature in this update? Let us know in the comments.
